title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mohegan Sun Arena, Uncasville | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut, USA, on 31 July 2003.

It was the seventh show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr returned to the Mohegan Sun Arena on 16 July 2006, 22 June 2008, 27 June 2010, 17 June 2012, and 20 September 2024.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
